route.metric: Correct additional admitted source/destination capability; otherwise full startup and CPU/resource cost.
route.audit: Trace actual input representation, requested tracks/features, current accepted plan and the decoder boundary. Check whether this adapter or destination is already used.
route.probe: Use one tiny admitted source plus one unsupported/near-boundary control through the existing destination or adapter; compare required output identity with the cheapest correct route. No broad codec port.
route.oracle: Configuration and ordered codec payloads where copy is intended; requested frames/audio/timeline/features at the declared output boundary.
route.negative: Alter one admission-critical configuration, remove a required dependency, or preserve video while making selected audio unsupported. Candidate must reject or use a declared fallback.
route.family_gate: Exact destination/configuration and existing source/worker assets; feature availability is not a pass for the complete route.
route.stop: Stop before a new demuxer, player, codec build family or delivery service is needed. Record precisely which next implementation would unlock the screen.

source.metric: Total bytes and time to correct startup/target, including cold index/identity acquisition; bounded retained bytes.
source.audit: Locate one real repeated read/index/validation boundary and its trusted source identity. Separate logical requests from transferred or physical-disk bytes.
source.probe: Replay a short owned range/seek trace on a tiny indexed fixture, including its first cold operation, with the same source and authorization. Reuse the existing reader.
source.oracle: Source/version identity, requested exact sample/frame, dependency coverage and byte-range accounting.
source.negative: Change the source/version or corrupt an offset/proof and cancel one consumer. No stale or unverified bytes may be published.
source.family_gate: Authorized seekable byte provider and a known oracle for sample prerequisites; no guessed remote-source semantics.
source.stop: Do not build a generic cache, transport server or index service for a first pass. Preserve a lower-cost component decision if real integration is E3.

lifecycle.metric: User-visible operation latency, duplicated work or peak/steady live resource ownership; not object counts alone.
lifecycle.audit: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard.
lifecycle.probe: One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
lifecycle.oracle: Actual output identity and timeline, surviving consumers, committed generations and cleanup; candidate execution must be visible.
lifecycle.negative: Cancel or replace a source at the changed boundary and delay a stale callback/consumer; reject late publication and premature reuse.
lifecycle.family_gate: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen.
lifecycle.stop: At the first need for a cross-backend ownership redesign, record DEFER_SETUP. Do not remove a semantically required reset or increase a timeout to hide a failure.

mux.metric: Complete preparation/startup/refill work, bytes and ownership; output parser acceptance alone is not the metric.
mux.audit: Find where bytes/timestamps actually change, are copied, or are withheld. Compare against current persistent mux/parser behavior.
mux.probe: Construct one bounded positive output and one invalid-edge control using the same coded samples. Keep unrelated fragment/default policies fixed.
mux.oracle: Independent parsing of sample payload, configuration, PTS/DTS/duration and required output; valid container plus continuing playback when this is the tested claim.
mux.negative: Wrong size/offset/configuration or a non-random-access cut must fail specifically; cancellation cannot publish another generation.
mux.family_gate: Existing parser/mux destination and matching native build where touched; no host-to-Wasm performance extrapolation.
mux.stop: Do not implement a universal mux engine, virtual file gateway or recovery journal to answer a tiny screen. Escalate scope explicitly.

subtitles.metric: Required caption capability or total render/extraction cost and retained cue/atlas memory.
subtitles.audit: Identify the exact subtitle representation, maintained renderer and existing cache behavior. Distinguish an oracle discrepancy from a player defect.
subtitles.probe: One authored cue/scene plus an overlapping or stateful boundary, using identical fonts, sizes and output semantics; reuse a maintained test.
subtitles.oracle: Independent rendering or browser-owned reference appropriate to the same contract, including hidden state, timing, ordering and clear events.
subtitles.negative: Seek into an active cue, change fonts/layout/source, or omit a required style/control. No silent simplification or stale overlay.
subtitles.family_gate: Same admitted subtitle renderer/assets; public cue-list/lifecycle compatibility must be addressed before virtualization.
subtitles.stop: No new subtitle service, full shaping engine or font-subsetting system during first pass. Defer if the necessary observer is not available.

gpu.metric: Complete decode/process/present cost, transfers, command work or peak live storage for identical requested output.
gpu.audit: Identify the CPU/GPU representation boundary and actual useful work removed. Check existing renderer fusions, caches, kernel fast paths and hardware gates.
gpu.probe: Small deterministic planes/blocks or an existing real frame with one adversarial edge. Use a bounded component test if GPU integration is not already available, labeling it as such.
gpu.oracle: Exact integer planes or an explicitly defined numerical/altered-output contract; compare the final requested region and later references where relevant.
gpu.negative: Change stride, crop, phase, alpha, edge neighborhood or resource generation; exercise a case where the proposed shortcut is ineligible.
gpu.family_gate: Actual required API/format for any GPU claim; CPU algebra is a separate component observation, not browser qualification.
gpu.stop: No custom decoder rewrite or GPU platform port. Include staging/readback/cache cost; reject the current implementation rather than the general idea if the executor is a proxy.

audio.metric: Complete specified audio operation, output sample count/phase and practical CPU/memory or repeated-query cost.
audio.audit: Write the exact requested signal operation, codec tool constraints, state and rounding contract. Check whether an optimized existing library already performs it.
audio.probe: A tiny independent numerical/bitstream oracle plus one boundary or adversarial case. Only use a matching Wasm slice when available and inexpensive.
audio.oracle: Exact PCM/encoded output where claimed; otherwise declared numeric tolerance against a stronger independent reference, including delay, tails and state.
audio.negative: Extrema, invalid precision, changed predictor/phase/history or a nonlinear stage must invalidate assumptions. No covert resampling/downmix/quality change.
audio.family_gate: Pinned processing recipe and relevant assets. Distinguish aggregate statistics from waveform, loudness, true peak and physical speaker behavior.
audio.stop: No full DSP pipeline or codec-state subsystem in the first pass. Count preparation/queries and do not promote algebra alone as an integrated gain.

preview.metric: Time to the requested exact or explicitly approximate preview, total prerequisite work and retained state.
preview.audit: Identify the preview operation and current service. Separate sparse previews, exact scrubbing and ordinary playback; inspect prior frame/history reuse.
preview.probe: One short owned source and a few target requests under equal memory budgets, with an independent full-decode/reference result.
preview.oracle: Correct source/time/target and agreed fidelity. Approximate results cannot populate exact caches or qualify normal playback.
preview.negative: Move backward, request a non-RAP dependency, change source or cancel a pending request; stale previews must never become current.
preview.family_gate: Existing preview or decoder access path. Its absence is setup cost, not permission to create a complete preview service.
preview.stop: Stop at E3 preview/index/state infrastructure. Keep proof of a bounded mechanism distinct from a production preview implementation.

tooling.metric: Decision power, reproducibility or diagnostic cost without changing the measured player outcome.
tooling.audit: Specify one concrete wrong-output or provenance failure the proposed tool must detect beyond the existing harness.
tooling.probe: Inject that failure in a tiny known-good fixture, demonstrate detection and run an unchanged control; do not build a general research platform.
tooling.oracle: Independent known truth plus a specific expected observation, not self-reported counters from the candidate.
tooling.negative: A different failure, stale source/hash or malformed record must not count as the intended finding.
tooling.family_gate: Existing fixtures and minimal observation surface; instrumentation overhead must be recorded separately.
tooling.stop: No dashboard, generic planner or broad testing framework. Retain a small reproducible assertion and move to the next item.
